§6Reactor Remote Control Block§f §aSet it and forget it. Auto-adjusts control rods so your reactor doesn't melt down while you're away.§f §bThe Reactor Remote Control Block§f remotely controls a research reactor's control rods based on parameters set in its GUI. §6Setup§f:
§b• 1.§f Right-click a functioning reactor with the Remote Sensor, place it in the control block slot
§b• 2.§f Display shows: §eLeft§f = rod extension, §eMiddle§f = neutron flux, §eRight§f = core temperature
§b• 3.§f Set min/max temperature (blue buttons) and rod levels at those temps (yellow buttons)
§b• 4.§f Choose rod movement: §bLinear§f, §bExponential§f, or §bLogarithmic§f
§b• 5.§f Save, rods auto-adjust to match temperature on the graph §6Features§f:
§b• Comparator output§f, emits signal proportional to reactor temperature for redstone alarms
§b• Maintains constant neutron rate§f for breeding operations
§b• Prevents overheating§f, rods react instantly to arrest runaway reactions §ePS:§f A properly configured remote control block makes a reactor very safe. It reacts faster than you can click the control rod GUI. Essential for unattended breeding.
